annotations.title: Publish static HTML to a Cloud site

description: Publishes self-contained HTML to one Cloud site this account owns and replaces that site’s live static page. Pass projectId instead of html to send a saved Studio page. Public env vars for that site are written into the page. Private values are not. Use deploy to make a page public. Use project to read or save source without publishing, create_project to create the site, and POST /api/cloud/v1/{siteId} with a Cloud deploy key for ZIP uploads. Cloud is not a Node host and has no server runtime.

html.description: Complete self-contained HTML document, 180 KB or smaller. Omit when projectId is set.

projectId.description: Optional Studio project UUID. Sends that saved page instead of html. Does not publish when the Studio page is empty.

siteId.description: UUID of a Cloud site this account owns. The published HTML for that site is replaced.

name: deploy
